title: Seizure false alarms and montage confounding
disposition_reason: The delivered analyst grade measures reconstruction of an answer-bearing event/annotation table. Its detector-generation programme source and montage reports are useful construction components, but a zero reconstruction error does not establish neural evidence interpretation or better seizure detection.

scientific_target.question: Does a frozen EEG detector improve complete held-person seizure detection over a matched no-EEG method, and does the paired improvement survive montage-stratified analysis?
scientific_target.known_answer: Held-person differences in event F1, sensitivity and false alarms per observed day for frozen EEG, matched no-EEG, montage-only and fixed signal-reference streams; null or inconclusive contrasts are valid answers.
scientific_target.answer_origin: Operator-held CHB-MIT annotations and frozen full-record predictions. The current analyst packet exposes annotations and prediction intervals for deterministic reconstruction.
scientific_target.case_unit: A complete 686-record CHB-MIT comparison panel, with localized false alarms nested in records and people.
scientific_target.independent_unit: 23 biological people, with chb01/chb21 merged; montage strata can have only one person.
scientific_target.inference_scope: Association of measured EEG use and detector errors within a public development cohort; matched method contrasts are conditional on actual fitting and channel handling.
exclusions: Neural understanding inferred from arithmetic reconstruction error
Artifact-type or causal attribution from unlabelled false-alarm windows
Independent replication inferred from montage rows or analyst replications

inputs: For actual target inference, held-person EEG and admissible montage information plus frozen training-only fit state.
For scoped analysis calibration only, released annotation/prediction tables and complete observed-duration metadata; these inputs disclose event truth.
forbidden_inputs: Held-person seizure annotations in a detector input
Final held-person outcomes used for detector or threshold selection
Treating current report reconstruction inputs as an unseen neural decoding query
observation_contract.case_identity: Source schedule requires 686 unique recording IDs and 23 person IDs; analyst contexts cross frozen-program/case-adaptive mode, three repetitions and two views. These are conditions, not independent tasks or people.
observation_contract.split: Source detector schedule uses nested biological-person selection: outer held person never supplies fitting labels; stronger arms search nine settings on inner held-person folds. Current analyst reconstruction occurs after prediction freeze and is a distinct task.
observation_contract.coverage: Full source programme schedules 92 final fold streams and all 686 recordings; recorded plan contains 9,706 fits, not executed fit evidence. Actual authentic complete corpus and programme execution remain unqualified.

primary.name: EEG_minus_matched_no_EEG_patient_macro_event_F1
primary.aggregation: Compute paired person F1 differences on all 23 people, then equal-person mean; preserve missing/undefined support.
primary.rationale: This signed scientific contrast can be positive, zero or negative; larger apparent neural contribution is not greater correctness of understanding. Any detector ranking uses absolute held-target event quality against an independently selected, frozen and operator-owned competent comparator, with false-alarm burden and all absolute arms retained. Candidate-controlled degradation of a nuisance arm cannot earn improvement. Submitted numerical-claim accuracy is error against the independently computed signed contrast, not reward for its sign. Historical report reconstruction remains numerical calibration.

secondary: Mandatory absolute event F1, sensitivity and false alarms per24 observed hours for candidate, fixed no-EEG, montage-only and signal-reference arms, with full person support; a delta alone is insufficient.
Montage-stratified paired contrasts with person support, including single-person flags
Exact false-alarm locations and durations; reconstruction tolerance as a separate software-calibration outcome
Absolute held-person event F1, sensitivity and false-alarm burden for every detector arm; any programme ranking is separate from signed neural-contribution reporting.

comparators.name: Matched no-EEG method
comparators.inputs: Same allowed nonsignal metadata and training labels; EEG removed
comparators.procedure: Operator selects and freezes the matched learner family, nine-setting search and inner-person selection before candidate evaluation. references/learners.py fixes joint/noEEG family and feature exclusion; the candidate cannot supply or weaken the comparator stream. Actual independent fitting and stream ownership must be authenticated.

comparators.name: Montage-only method
comparators.procedure: Source fixed comparison arm; support and person confounding reported.

comparators.name: Fixed signal reference
comparators.inputs: Median channel line-length-related features from EEG
comparators.procedure: Source reference arm; empirical competence is not established by its presence.

nuisance_controls: Keep identical recording hours and event processing across arms.
Group biological identity aliases and freeze training-only selection.
Do not label false alarms as movement/electrode artifacts without independent annotations.
Inspect single-person montage strata; montage differences do not identify a montage effect independently of patient.
The independent operator owns fixed no-EEG predictions and their fit/selection lineage; candidate-authored nuisance predictions do not establish incremental neural value.
evaluation.uncertainty: Source reports paired person means and standard errors descriptively; repetition of analyst prompts does not increase biological n. An inferential superiority claim additionally needs a predeclared paired procedure accounting for nested training dependence.
evaluation.failure_policy: Require all 686 recordings, all expected analyst contexts and exact report support; reject malformed report scalars/IDs. A scientifically missing detector stream must remain a failed condition, never become a perfect reconstructed table.

implementation.scorer_target: analysis_core.grade returns maximum_scaled_reconstruction_error against a deterministic report reconstructed from annotations and arm intervals. grading.grade_all adds a matched diagnostic and explicitly sets native_waveform_understanding_established=false.
implementation.delivered_scope: A full-cohort source programme and analyst reconstruction transport exist; the analyst score is numerical evidence reproduction, not the revised empirical incremental-neural endpoint.
missing: Bind completed authentic detector streams and grade their fixed neural-versus-nonneural outcomes as the scientific primary.
Release a target-withholding investigation view rather than the current answer-bearing reconstruction table.
Establish actual nested-fit and source/channel provenance plus signal reference competence.
Bind the primary to an independently frozen operator-owned no-EEG reference and require all absolute arm metrics; the historical reconstruction score remains unchanged.
implementation.execution_evidence: Source graph and scorer inspected; no new analyst, detector, native source or model campaign was run.

direct_observation.representation: A no-tools analyst may interpret an operator-produced numerical evidence display, but current complete table copying does not test a withheld scientific answer.

typed_viewer.representation: Viewing EEG false-alarm windows could support localization review, but an image cannot by itself establish a whole-cohort matched contrast; no typed transport is delivered.
typed_viewer.boundary: Only typed render/navigation actions with audited limits; no raw arrays, labels, filenames or external source retrieval returned to the participant.

summary: Demote reconstruction error to calibration and define the genuine held-person EEG contribution as the primary endpoint.
Make montage/patient confounding and unsupported artifact attribution explicit.
Require independent comparator ownership and all absolute arm endpoints to prevent a participant increasing the reported gap by degrading its no-EEG arm.
